title: True Blue Account: Treasury Services Integration
summary: Covers True Blue Account treasury services integration: the monthly link fee is $0.00 and Cash Management Dashboard access is included at no additional cost. Explains enabling via an administrative profile request, assigning authorized company signers, completing credential exchange, and then verifying permissions and reconciling the first file exchange.
